contradictions.difference: 14 directions omitted B11/B12 and included B07/B08; 22 directions included intermediate forward exports F07–F13; canonical JSON defines 9 backward + 6 forward = 15 required directions.
contradictions.why_it_matters: Establishes the immutable 15/15 denominator as the only canonical standard for MP1-V002 protocol completion.
